svg.title: Radioactive decay
svg.desc: The number of radioactive nuclei, N, starting from 1,000,000, versus time in multiples of the half-life t1/2. Each half-life halves the number: 500,000 after one half-life, 250,000 after two, 125,000 after three, down to 977 after ten. The curve is an exponential decay, and a table beside it lists the values.
